name: NHB
recent: NHB 正在推进最多 10% 的私募配售以及 1 送 2 红股计划，并已于 11 月 25 日向 Bursa Securities 提交上市申请。公司同时宣布以合计 RM98 million 现金收购 Armani Sinar 全部股权及 Armani Energy 的太阳能资产，相关完成日期已延至 2026 年 12 月 31 日。此外，公司近期获得一份价值 RM10.1 million 的 Labuan 电厂工程合约。
notable: 以及按 1 送 2 比例发行最多 106,957,767 股红股。
并以 RM68 million 现金收购 Armani Energy 的太阳能资产。
获得价值 RM10.1 million 的 Labuan 电厂工程合约。
risks: 私募配售最多 10% 新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
太阳能资产收购的完成日期已从 2026 年 9 月 30 日延至 2026 年 12 月 31 日，尚待国家电力公司同意相关合约更替。

news.title: Nuenergy Files Bursa Application for 10% Placement and 106.96 Million Bonus Shares
NuEnergy secures RM10.1mil engineering contract for Labuan power plant

recent_en: NHB is proceeding with a private placement of up to 10% and a 1-for-2 bonus issue, having submitted its listing application to Bursa Securities on 25 November. The company also announced cash acquisitions of 100% of Armani Sinar and solar assets in Armani Energy for a combined RM98 million, with the completion date extended to 31 December 2026. It recently secured a RM10.1 million engineering contract for a Labuan power plant.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% and a bonus issue of up to 106,957,767 shares on a 1-for-2 basis.
Proposed cash acquisition of 100% of Armani Sinar for RM30 million and solar assets in Armani Energy for RM68 million.
Secured a RM10.1 million engineering contract for a Labuan power plant.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
The completion date for the solar assets acquisition has been extended from 30 September 2026 to 31 December 2026, pending consent from the national electric utility for contract novation.
